nick.description: The user's display nickname in the Tox network.

force_tcp.description: Force TCP connection, typically required when using proxies.

tcp_relay.description: Act as a TCP relay server for the network (high bandwidth usage).

noconnect.description: Start the client without connecting to the DHT network.

socks5_proxy.description: SOCKS5 proxy settings in format '[IP] [port]'. Leave empty to disable.

http_proxy.description: HTTP proxy settings in format '[IP] [port]'. Leave empty to disable.

tox_log.description: Enable detailed toxcore logging to stderr.

debug.description: Enable general client debugging output to stderr.

default_locale.description: Force the use of the default locale.

nodes_file.description: Path to the JSON file containing DHT bootstrap nodes.

data_file.description: Path to the file storing personal profile data and Tox ID.

config_file.description: Path to the main configuration file.
